robot.probe_looks_follower: {{v}} V: looks like a follower arm

calibrate.title: Calibrate
calibrate.desc: One guided flow: follower, then leader, then a quick check that both arms agree.
calibrate.checking: Reading the calibration stored in the motors…
calibrate.ok_title: {{arm}} arm is calibrated: ready to use
calibrate.ok_text: The motors hold the calibration of this robot's own file. Nothing to do.
calibrate.adopt_title: This arm already uses the calibration from LeLab: {{file}}
calibrate.adopt_text: Its motors carry exactly this file's values. Use it and Station saves a copy as {{own}}.
calibrate.mismatch_title: {{arm}} arm: the motors do not keep the calibration file
calibrate.mismatch_text: The file exists but the motors read back other values. Calibrate again (about a minute), or try writing the file once more.
calibrate.needs_text: Two steps, about a minute: put the arm in the middle, then move each joint through its full range.
calibrate.other_files: Calibration files of the {{arm}} arm on this computer:
calibrate.no_files: No other calibration file for this arm.
calibrate.limp: The follower is limp: hold it.
calibrate.arm_alt: SO-101 arm with every joint in the middle of its range
calibrate.home_title: Put the arm in the middle
calibrate.home_text: Move every joint to the middle of its range, like the picture, then press Set home.
calibrate.ranges_title: Move each joint through its full range
calibrate.ranges_text: One joint at a time, slowly from one end to the other (wrist roll too). A joint is ticked once it has moved enough.
calibrate.finish_hint: Save unlocks when every joint is ticked.
calibrate.check_title: Hold the leader in the same pose as the follower
calibrate.check_text: The follower holds still. Move the leader so that it looks exactly like the follower, then press Check.
calibrate.check_ok: Both arms agree (largest difference {{max}}). Ready for teleop.
calibrate.check_bad_pose: Put the leader in the follower's pose once more and check again.
calibrate.check_bad_file: Still apart: that arm probably uses a wrong calibration file. Recalibrate it.
calibrate.check_bad_roles: Every joint apart: leader and follower may be swapped (Robot > ports).

lost.title: Lost the USB connection to the {{arm}} arm ({{port}})
lost.what: The serial device went away: the cable or the USB port, the arm's power, Windows putting the USB port to sleep, or another program took the port. Station stopped without retrying.
lost.jump_hint: It happened right after the torque came on or teleop started: a big jump (leader and follower far apart, or a wrong calibration file) draws a current spike that can brown out the follower's supply. Put the leader in the follower's pose and run Calibrate > Check both arms.
lost.check_cable: Check the USB cable of the {{arm}} arm (both ends; avoid unpowered hubs and long extensions).
lost.check_power: Check the follower's power supply (the adapter is plugged in, enough current: 5 A for 12 V).
lost.check_other: Close LeLab, lerobot or any other program that may use this port.
lost.check_suspend: Windows: turn off USB selective suspend (Control Panel > Power Options > Change plan settings > Advanced > USB settings) and the "allow the computer to turn off this device" option of the USB port in Device Manager.
lost.check_replug: Unplug and plug the USB cable back in, then press Reconnect.
lost.waiting: Waiting for the port to come back… plug the cable back in.

teleop.aligning: Follower moving slowly to the leader pose… keep the leader still. Space stops it.

tooltips.hb_start: The program starts here. Only the blocks under it run.
tooltips.hb_play_trajectory: Replays a saved trajectory; moves to its start first when the arm is elsewhere.
tooltips.hb_move_to_pose: Smooth move to a saved pose at a capped speed.
tooltips.hb_gripper: Open, close or set the gripper (0 closed, 100 open).
tooltips.hb_go_home: Back to the robot's rest pose.
tooltips.hb_relax_arm: Park, then turn the torque off. The next motion turns it back on.
tooltips.hb_run_model_for: Runs an AI model for a fixed time.
tooltips.hb_run_model_until: Runs an AI model until the condition holds.
tooltips.hb_repeat_forever: Repeats the blocks inside until the program stops. Needs a motion or a wait inside.
tooltips.hb_wait: Waits for a number of seconds.
tooltips.hb_wait_until: Waits until the condition holds, at most for the timeout.
tooltips.hb_camera_sees: True when the detector returns this label on the camera.
tooltips.hb_button_pressed: True once per press of an operator button.
tooltips.hb_key_pressed: True once per press of a key (Space stays the e-stop).
tooltips.hb_ask_operator: Shows a question with choices and stores the answer in a text variable.
tooltips.hb_gripper_holding: True when the closed gripper is blocked by an object.
tooltips.hb_joint_compare: Compares a joint position with a value in degrees.
tooltips.hb_joint_value: The joint position in degrees (gripper 0 to 100).
tooltips.hb_near_pose: True when every joint is within the tolerance of the pose.
tooltips.hb_motor_temp_compare: Compares a motor temperature with a value.
tooltips.hb_signal_equals: True when the signal has this value.
tooltips.hb_message_received: True when a new message arrived since the last check.
tooltips.hb_log: Writes a line to the run log.
tooltips.hb_notify: Shows a message on the run screen (and optionally calls the webhook).
tooltips.hb_set_signal: Sets a signal other programs and devices can read.
